about_the_game:
Scrollmapper is an innovative scripture analysis tool designed to create detailed cross-references for both canonical and apocryphal scriptures. It's primary purpose is to connect the canonical scriptures to the lost books such as the Book of Enoch.

Built using Godot game engine, Scrollmapper offers a visually appealing and intuitive interface for exploring and analyzing scripture relationships.

Scrollmapper Key Features:

  • Scripture Mapping: Create and visualize complex relationships between scriptures using an advanced graphing method.

  • Gephi Integration: Export cross-references to Gephi for deep analysis, allowing users to uncover intricate connections within the scriptures.

  • Comprehensive Database: Pre-populated with 340,000 cross-references, enabling immediate exploration and analysis.

  • Meta Editing: Attach custom metadata to individual verses for enhanced filtering and analysis.

  • Book Importing and Reading: Import books directly from Scrollmapper databases on GitHub and read them within the app.

  • Open Source: Scrollmapper is open-source, encouraging community contributions and continuous improvement.

Whether you are a scholar, researcher, or simply someone interested in biblical studies, Scrollmapper provides the tools you need to delve deeper into the scriptures and discover new insights.
